description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the System altar at its grandest: a tall black stone obelisk blazing with glowing light blue runes on a high round dais of grey stone steps, a ring of black standing stones joined by thin beams of light blue light, a soft light blue glow rising above it with many small floating lights, many candles on the steps

references.usage: the first, smallest stage of this same building, chosen by the author: keep its stone, timber, roof colours, outlines and pixel style, and draw the bigger, richer next stage of it
